function.name: start_session
function.description: Start a new named shell session (Ubuntu bash, root) on the phone VPS. Sessions keep their working directory and variables between commands.

name.description: Session name, letters/digits/_.- only, e.g. bot1

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command in a session and return its output and exit code. If timed_out is true the command is still running; read the rest with read_output.

function.name: send_input
function.description: Send text to the running command's stdin, e.g. to answer a prompt. End with \n to press Enter.

function.name: interrupt
function.description: Press Ctrl+C in a session to stop the running command.

function.name: read_output
function.description: Read buffered output of a session from an offset (use next_offset from the previous call). Useful for long or background commands.

function.name: stop_session
function.description: Stop a session and everything running in it.
